# Vendor Agreement — DataStream Analytics LLC

## Parties

This agreement is between Aurora Robotics Inc. ("Customer") and DataStream Analytics LLC ("Vendor"), for the provision of telemetry data analytics and storage pipeline services used to process flight data collected by the Falcon Drone fleet.

## Term

This agreement was signed in June 2023 for an initial term of 2 years, expiring in June 2025. The agreement automatically renews for successive 1-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the then-current term ends.

## Services

DataStream Analytics LLC operates the data pipeline that ingests, processes, and stores telemetry data generated by Falcon Drone v1 and Falcon Drone v2 units in the field, including flight logs, sensor readings, and LIDAR point cloud data. Processed data is made available to Aurora Robotics' fleet management dashboard for customer reporting.

## Fees

Aurora Robotics pays DataStream Analytics LLC an annual fee of $210,000, invoiced monthly at $17,500 per month.

## Service Level Agreement

DataStream Analytics LLC guarantees 99.5% monthly uptime for the data ingestion pipeline, and commits to a minimum data retention period of 5 years for all processed telemetry data.

## Termination

Either party may terminate this agreement with 60 days' written notice. Aurora Robotics retains the right to export all stored telemetry data for a period of 90 days following termination.
